page.overview:
Who is Ajit Dayal?

Ajit Dayal () is a member of House Dayal, a Mahaan house in Jrusar, and oversees the Dayal Hall. Gurge Kisgregg instructed Chetney Pock O'Pea to find Ajit, who could further connect him to the Gorgynei.

Ajit is described by Gryz Alakritos, a socially nervous friend, as suited for large social occasions like balls and "much better at this". Gryz also felt that Ajit was "a good man". He is described by Eshteross as "a philanthropic sort" and as having almost "too good" of a reputation within the city, which Eshteross felt made him a target.

When Bells Hells visited him at Dayal Hall, Ajit wore a dark colored sherwani coat. He has deep brown skin, short dark hair, kind eyes, and a friendly and open manner.

Ajit is a member of House Dayal, a Mahaan house in Jrusar. He oversees the Dayal Hall, an educational center located in the Core Spire. He was a student of Daramon.
